arguments.argument: One row per campaign, ranked against each other: how many sends, how many converted, the conversion rate, revenue (Model\Campaign\AttributionCalculator's equal-weight multi-touch split across every campaign a customer clicked through before ordering — not single-touch "last campaign before the order"), and the average projected lifetime value (Model\Clv\ClvCalculator) of the customers it converted. A campaign that has never sent anything still shows as a 0 row; "Avg. Converted Customer CLV" is blank, not $0, when a campaign hasn't converted anyone yet.
